newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures close with steep losses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures close with steep losses.

text.p: March 13 - U.S. stock index futures closed sharply lower and near the lows of the day set late. Fed chairman Rivlin's comments that the economy is "perking along" and that the Fed needed to watch for an inflation pickup pressured bonds, which weighed on index futures, despite some softening of those remarks later. Light arb selling also fueled losses in cash.
